title: Relation Proposal
description: Experiment 6's response shape. Relations are proposed over observations THIS LAB already recorded, and no image is re-sent — so whatever comes back is a reading of a reading, twice removed from anything measured. `grounded_in` must name the observation indices the relation rests on; a relation that cites nothing is a relation the model invented, and the schema makes that visible rather than fixing it.

grounded_in.description: Indices into the observation list that was supplied. Empty means ungrounded.

declined.description: Relations the model was unwilling to propose from these observations alone.
